messages:
violet_csm: Heads-up: DynamiQ (mid-market) flagged higher-than-expected costs and inconsistent p95 during their onboarding. Renewal check-in in 18 days. Theyuse heavy multi-turn summarization + reranking. Want a low-risk perf plan to show cost reduction without hurting accuracy. Ideas: 1) trial 4-bit quant compact model for non-core routes, 2) regional route split (cheap region for batch), 3) short prefix cache warmup flow. Thoughts?

marta_cs: Important: customer will not accept any measurable downgrade on their top-traffic workflow (legal-doc summaries). We can touch background flows (support auto-summaries, content extracts). Need clear success metrics for them: p95 <= 220ms for critical, cost delta >= 15% overall.

rui_swe: OK. I propose a three-phase pilot: Phase A (48h) traffic-only canary at 8% to compact-7b-4bit; Phase B (48h) increase to 25% if no regressions; Phase C evaluate long-run routing to eu-north for batch jobs. I'll instrument a split route that isolates summaries by label. Example quick route rule (pseudo): ```
route: /summaries
  if tag=="background" -> model: redwood/7b-4bit-compact (canary 8%)
  else -> model: redwood/13b-v2
fallback: redwood/13b-v2
metrics: eval_diff, latency_p95, error_rate
```

anya_ops: ops notes: need to pre-warm KV cache before canary ramp. We'll run synthetic warmup scripts pointing to the compact model for repeating prefixes. Also recommend setting token-rate limits on canary to avoid cold spikes.

ezra_sre: SRE guardrails: automatic rollback if hallucination_score increases >0.7% absolute or error_rate >0.4% in 15m window. Capture per-model ROUGE/BERTScore on our eval suite. Add tracing to show KV cache hit ratio and model time-by-token. Also capture region cost breakdown (us-east vs eu-north).

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: dynamiq-4bit-canary (region: eu-north) 1 pods -> 6. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/dynamiq-4bit-canary

violet_csm: Customer asks: can we run a blind A/B eval with their acceptance team before full ramp? They want example prompts and an SLA clause for fallback.

rui_swe: We'll produce an A/B deck: 40 real customer prompts (redacted) + automated eval run. Command: `./bin/evaluate --left redwood/13b-v2 --right redwood/7b-4bit-compact --suite dynamiq_ab.json --metrics rouge,bert,halluc` Output will be emailed and shared in Drive.

anya_ops: scheduling: pre-warm job in eu-north in 30m, then start 8% canary for 48h. Please confirm customer window so we can align.

violet_csm: I'll request a 48h window next Tue 9am PT. Also will collect acceptance stakeholders and legal for data handling.

ezra_sre: I'll add an oncall rotation for the first 6 hours of the canary and set alerts to page if rollback conditions hit.

violet_csm: Great, capture notes here and I'll post customer feedback after 48h. Thanks team :thumbsup: 

(reacts: :white_check_mark: from rui_swe, :memo: from marta_cs)
